definition: A brightly colored leaf-like part of a blossom that attracts pollinating insects.
example: The bee landed gently on the soft red _____ to drink sweet liquid.
vietnamese: Cánh hoa (bộ phận rực rỡ thu hút côn trùng).

definition: The outer green leaf-like structure that encloses and shields a budding flower.
example: Before blooming open, the tight bud was wrapped safely inside green _____s.
vietnamese: Lá đài hoa (bọc bảo vệ nụ hoa trước khi nở).

definition: The male reproductive organ of a blossom consisting of a stalk and pollen sac.
example: Yellow powdery dust coated the tall slender _____ in the blossom center.
vietnamese: Nhị hoa (cơ quan sinh sản đực của hoa).

definition: The tip portion of the male plant stalk that produces and holds pollen grains.
example: Pollen grains brushed off the powdery _____ onto the bumblebee fuzzy legs.
vietnamese: Bao phấn (túi phấn trên đỉnh chỉ nhị).

definition: The thin supporting stem that holds up the pollen-producing tip in a blossom.
example: A breeze gently swayed the delicate _____ holding up the pollen sac.
vietnamese: Chỉ nhị (cuống nâng đỡ bao phấn).

definition: The female reproductive structure of a plant consisting of top, neck, and base.
example: The central _____ receives incoming pollen to produce developing embryos.
vietnamese: Nhụy hoa (cơ quan sinh sản cái của hoa).

definition: The moist, sticky landing surface at the top of the female plant organ.
example: Windblown grains stuck tightly to the gooey surface of the blossom _____.
vietnamese: Đầu nhụy (phần dính ở đỉnh nhụy tiếp nhận hạt phấn).

definition: The narrow neck connecting the sticky pollen-catcher to the swollen base.
example: Pollen tubes grow downward through the elongated _____ towards the egg chamber.
vietnamese: Vòi nhụy (ống nối giữa đầu nhụy và bầu nhụy).

definition: The swollen bottom chamber of the female organ that swells into a fruit.
example: After fertilisation occurs, the swollen _____ develops into a sweet fleshy apple.
vietnamese: Bầu nhụy (phần phình to dưới đáy nhụy phát triển thành quả).

definition: The small egg structure inside the plant chamber that develops into a seed.
example: Inside the green pea pod, each fertilised _____ transformed into a round pea.
vietnamese: Noãn (hạt mầm cái bên trong bầu nhụy sẽ hóa thành hạt).

definition: Microscopic reproductive units made by non-flowering flora instead of seeds.
example: Fern plants produce powdery brown _____ on the undersides of their fronds.
vietnamese: Bào tử (hạt sinh sản siêu nhỏ của cây không hoa).

definition: A leafy green non-flowering plant with feathery fronds reproducing via spores.
example: A lush green _____ grew beside the shady stream in the forest floor.
vietnamese: Cây dương xỉ (loài thực vật không hoa có lá xẻ lông chim).

definition: A tiny non-flowering green plant that forms dense carpets on damp rocks and soil.
example: Soft velvet _____ covered the slippery river stones in the damp valley.
vietnamese: Cây rêu (thực vật nhỏ bé phủ thảm xanh ẩm ướt).

definition: The woody cone of an evergreen conifer tree that contains naked seeds.
example: The brown _____ opened its woody scales to let its winged seeds drift away.
vietnamese: Nón thông / quả thông (cơ quan chứa hạt trần của cây lá kim).

definition: A tiny young plant that has just emerged from an opened seed coat.
example: Watering the soil helped the fragile _____ sprout its first two green leaves.
vietnamese: Cây mầm con (cây non mới nảy mầm).

definition: The biological process in which a dormant seed absorbs water and begins growing.
example: Warm soil and regular moisture are crucial requirements for successful _____.
vietnamese: Sự nảy mầm của hạt giống.

definition: The complete series of stages an organism passes through from birth to reproduction.
example: The plant _____ progresses from seed to flower, fruit, and new seed.
vietnamese: Vòng đời sinh trưởng và sinh sản.

definition: Fine yellowish powder grains produced by male organs of seed plants.
example: The honeybee was dusted all over in golden _____ from visiting blossoms.
vietnamese: Hạt phấn hoa (bột vàng mang tế bào sinh sản đực).

definition: An insect or animal that moves powdery grains from one bloom to another.
example: The humming butterfly acts as an important _____ in our school garden.
vietnamese: Sinh vật thụ phấn (ong, bướm, chim hút mật).

definition: To transfer powdery fertilising grains onto a female blossom landing pad.
example: Worker bees buzz across fields to _____ blooming apple trees.
vietnamese: Thực hiện việc thụ phấn.

definition: A sugary liquid secretion produced by blossoms to lure foraging visitors.
example: Hungry insects dive deep into the blossom tube to drink sweet _____.
vietnamese: Mật hoa (dịch ngọt tiết ra để dụ côn trùng).

definition: The fusing of a male nucleus from pollen with a female egg inside an ovule.
example: Following successful _____, the flower petals wither and seeds begin to form.
vietnamese: Sự thụ tinh (kết hợp giữa phấn hoa và noãn).

definition: A pleasant fragrant smell produced by blossoms to attract distant insects.
example: Jasmine blossoms release a powerful _____ as dusk settles.
vietnamese: Hương thơm ngọt ngào của hoa.

definition: The scattering or spreading of plant propagules far from the mother organism.
example: Fruit consumption by birds aids in effective seed _____ across forests.
vietnamese: Sự phát tán hạt giống đi xa.

definition: A meadow plant with yellow blooms and globe heads of wind-blown parachute seeds.
example: Children blow the fluffy white head of a _____ to watch the fluff fly.
vietnamese: Hoa bồ công anh (hạt có túm lông dù bay trong gió).

definition: A light, umbrella-like plume of fine hairs that catches air to carry a seed.
example: Each tiny grain is attached to a feathery _____ that drifts upon the breeze.
vietnamese: Túm lông dù đón gió của hạt giống.

definition: A large deciduous tree bearing winged fruits that twirl like miniature helicopters.
example: Twin winged seeds of the _____ spin gracefully down from high branches.
vietnamese: Cây phong tiêu (cho hạt có cánh bay liệng như trực thăng).

definition: Sharp, rigid projections on seed husks that snag tightly onto passing creatures.
example: Burdock seeds have stiff prickles and _____ that latch onto socks and fur.
vietnamese: Gai nhọn trên vỏ quả/hạt giống.

definition: Curved pointy claws on seed cases that cling stubbornly to animal coats.
example: The shepherd brushed clingy burrs with tiny curved _____ off his sheep wool.
vietnamese: Móc gai cong bám vào lông thú.

definition: A large waterproof fibrous drupe capable of floating long distances across oceans.
example: The tough husk allows a floating _____ to drift across the ocean to new shores.
vietnamese: Quả dừa biển (phát tán hạt nhờ trôi nổi trên mặt nước).

definition: A coastal shoreline tree whose dart-like saplings drop and anchor in marine mud.
example: Pointed pencil-like fruits drop straight down from the coastal _____ into tidal mud.
vietnamese: Cây đước (rừng ngập mặn ven biển).

definition: The sudden violent splitting open of dried legumes to fling grains across distances.
example: Under the hot sun, drying pea husks snap and _____ with a soft pop.
vietnamese: Vỏ đậu khô nổ tung để bắn hạt đi xa.

definition: To take in or soak up moisture and liquid through porous outer surfaces.
example: Dry beans must _____ water through their skins before sprouting can occur.
vietnamese: Hấp thụ, hút nước và dưỡng chất.

definition: A rapid and continuous back-and-forth oscillation that generates sound energy.
example: Plucking a tight guitar string sets off a rapid _____ you can feel.
vietnamese: Sự rung động tạo ra sóng âm thanh.

definition: How high or low a perceived auditory tone sounds to the ear.
example: Tighter strings on a violin produce a noticeably higher _____.
vietnamese: Cao độ của âm thanh (âm trầm hay bổng).

definition: The degree of loudness or acoustic intensity of an audible sound.
example: Turn down the television _____ so the sleeping baby is not disturbed.
vietnamese: Âm lượng (độ to nhỏ của âm thanh).

definition: The rate at which complete wave cycles oscillate within one second.
example: A high whistle creates thousands of wave cycles per second at high _____.
vietnamese: Tần số dao động sóng âm.

definition: A state of substance having a definite, firm shape and fixed volume.
example: Frozen ice is water in its hard _____ form.
vietnamese: Thể rắn (hình dạng và thể tích cố định).

definition: A fluid substance that maintains constant volume but takes the shape of its dish.
example: Pouring fresh milk into a glass shows how a _____ flows easily.
vietnamese: Thể lỏng (chảy được, có thể tích cố định nhưng đổi hình dạng).

definition: An airy state of matter that expands without limit to fill any space.
example: Invisible water vapour rising from the kettle is water as a _____.
vietnamese: Thể khí / hơi (lan tỏa tự do lấp đầy không gian).

definition: The gradual surface conversion of a fluid into vaporous airborne molecules.
example: Puddles dry up quickly on sunny days through rapid _____.
vietnamese: Sự bay hơi từ bề mặt chất lỏng.

definition: The change of gaseous vapor back into tiny droplets upon encountering cool surfaces.
example: Warm breath against cold window glass creates cloudy _____ droplets.
vietnamese: Sự ngưng tụ từ thể khí thành giọt nước.
